Merge the web-only work (`mngr/hopefully-last-web-details`) into main. Adds the server side of the hosted, browser-only minds client and moves accounts onto a hosted surface:

New `POST /hosts/claim` (browser-driven one-call workspace creation: fast-path lease of a pool host matching the tier's pinned template + shape, SSH adopt of the pre-baked workspace, boot via the shared start script, then share bring-up) and `POST /keys/workspace-mint` (the web chrome's twin of the desktop mint page). Resource endpoints (`/hosts/*`, `/sync/*`, `/keys/*`, buckets, cleanup grants) now also accept the SuperTokens browser-session cookie, and cookie auth on every quota-checked endpoint is fixed.

New `frontend_web/` web-chrome SPA (Mithril + Tailwind + Vite) served under `/web`: sign-in rides the accounts browser session; master-password flows are wire-compatible with the desktop's secret wrapping; browser-orchestrated create generates the workspace keypair in-browser, pushes an encrypted CAS record, provisions backups over the Ed25519-signed owner-exec channel, and iframes the workspace.

Shared workspaces record a routable **entry origin** (new `entry_label` column, migration 023) so the chrome enters/probes/iframes `<entry_label>.<domain>` instead of the deliberately-unrouted bare domain. SuperTokens session cookies are now `SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned` (CHIPS) so the session is readable inside the cross-site workspace iframe (owner enters silently). Enable-sharing seeds `share_grants.toml` only when absent (no longer clobbering user-added grants), the owner-exec grants client speaks a compare-and-swap contract, and `PUT /sync/bundle` gains a create-only mode.

New hosted accounts surface: Minds-branded `/login`, `/signup`, `/manage` pages (`frontend/` bundle) with a JSON API under `/accounts/api/*`, native SuperTokens cookie sessions, a PKCE device handoff (`/accounts/authorize` + `POST /auth/device/token`, migration 022) for the desktop app/CLI, and the share broker merged onto the same surface. Email verification is non-blocking (only share visits and ally eligibility require it, via a new `require_verified_email` guard); the old JSON auth endpoints are deprecated in favor of the browser flow.
